messages:
nina: quick idea  when saving a per-route saved-view that pins a model, console should capture the routing policy + sampling knobs so analytics can run apples-to-apples comparisons later. anyone object to storing `telemetry_keys` with the saved query?

marta: no objections. we should also store `preview_basis` and `cache_adj` so previews are reproducible. UX: show a tiny badge on saved views: "telemetry-ready" with a hover listing the keys.

raj: agree. need stable keys: `route`, `preset_id`, `preview_id`, `model`, `variant`, `preview_basis`, `sampling_rate`. also emit `rollout_policy` fields in spans: `policy_preference`, `canary_pct`, `fallbacks`.

devon: how does this affect migration? existing saved queries won't have telemetry_keys. plan: treat missing keys as legacy and surface a small "enable telemetry tagging" CTA when user opens the saved view. clicking it runs a lightweight preview to seed tags.

marta: add `created_by` and `created_at` to the metadata so analysts can filter out pre-tagged entries. also add `last_preview_run` with `preview_basis` so folks can track drift.

analytics-bot: analytics-bot: recommend `sampling_rate` be explicit and capped in console UI (server caps at 0.2). include `preview_sample_window` (e.g., 7d/14d) so joins to billing are aligned.

raj: backend sketch (authoritative saved preset payload):
```json
{
  "preset_id":"ps-2109",
  "scope":{"route_id":"r-210","pinned_model":"rwin-4"},
  "telemetry_keys":["route:r-210","preset:ps-2109","model:rwin-4","variant:quant"],
  "preview_meta":{"preview_id":"pv-2109","preview_basis":"7d_hist","cache_adj":0.18,"sampling_rate":0.01},
  "policy":{"preference":["latency","cost"],"canary_pct":0.05,"fallbacks":["rwin-4","rwin-4-quant"]},
  "created_by":"nina",
  "created_at":"2025-06-01T16:22:00Z"
}
```

devon: console UX: saved-view card shows aggregate tokens + a chevron to expand per-model breakdown if pinned. small "simulate" link opens a quick modal that runs a structured preview (server returns by-model array + confidence) and shows quota delta.

marta: add an audit-note on commit: `commit_id` and `preview_id` must be logged to the org audit stream. enterprise tenants get `approval_required` if estimated monthly delta > $1000.

raj: telemetry/tracing plan: every request served from a pinned preset should attach `preset_id` and `variant` to the span. preview runs should emit `preview_id` and `preview_basis`. in metrics pipeline we can then separate previewed vs actual traffic.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: small canary for presets-telemetry tagging scheduled 2025-06-11T04:00:00Z (team: eng-platform).

nina: ok i'll write a short spec and a tiny prototype for the saved-view card (chevron + simulate modal) and drop it in console/docs/saved-views. ping if you want to pair on the preview API shape. short thread.
